title: Reflex: the decision flow — state in, calibrated answer or honest abstain out
intro: Press play to walk the flow one step at a time, or click a dot to jump.

walk.title: You ask
walk.text: Your app sends a state plus typed questions over loopback — choice, score or yes-no. Nothing leaves your machine.

in.label: POST /decide
in.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (answered request)

walk.title: Embed and route
walk.text: The state is hashed into features and the domain argmax picks your corpus — the corpus IS the model here; no neural weights, no AI service.

walk.title: Score every option
walk.text: Each option is scored against the corpus: the drafter's compressed-length delta blended with the query's cosine to the option's corpus centroid — the cosine is the signal that ranks.

walk.title: Calibrate
walk.text: A sigmoid gate turns the signal into confidence. The calibrator starts bit-identical to the raw readout and refits only from outcome evidence you supply — offline, one-off, yours.

walk.title: Signal — the answer
walk.text: With signal, one pick per question goes back with calibrated confidence and the full distribution riding beside it. This game-head question is one the engine is sure on.

walk.title: No signal — the honest abstain
walk.text: Off-corpus or low confidence yields outcome null: the engine declines instead of guessing, and the full distribution still rides for risk-coverage analysis. This kitchen question is nowhere near the corpus — the distance gate catches it.

walk.title: Refit from your data
walk.text: Thresholds are fitted offline from labeled outcomes — never telemetry. The feedback wire is where outcome labels come back: report whether a past answer was right, and the engine recalibrates once it has enough reports.
